user.title: Home Energy Manager
user.description: Enter the address of the machine running Home Energy Manager and the API key from Settings → Remote / Mobile Network Access → Authenticated API. The key is shown only once when generated.

data.use_ssl: Use HTTPS (only if HEM is behind a TLS reverse proxy)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter API key
reauth_confirm.description: Home Energy Manager rejected the stored key. Generate a new one in HEM and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the API. Check the host, the API port (default 7338, not the 7337 dashboard), the listen address in HEM and any firewall.

abort.already_configured: This Home Energy Manager is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Home Energy Manager entry.

init.title: Options
init.description: Battery controls are off by default. HEM also needs its own 'Allow battery control through the authenticated API' toggle enabled before any start command is accepted.

data.poll_snapshot: Also poll /api/snapshot for power and energy readings
data.enable_controls: Enable battery controls (switches, stop buttons, duration)
data.confirm_timeout: Command readback timeout (0 disables confirmation polling)
data.dashboard_port: Dashboard port (used for the device's 'Visit' link)
